physics_informed_companion.interpretation: Predictively indistinguishable from the MLP; retained for physics-consistency and sensitivity analysis.

pet_constraint_decision: Do not use PET-constrained PINNs as primary models. Retain them only as ablations because they reduced physical violations but worsened ensemble geographic RMSE.
important_limitation: Geographic generalization is conditional on the fixed precipitation NMF representation fitted before spatial CV.
